items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’m having a second socially distanced lunch with a friend of mine who is 87 now, Perry Botkin Jr.

ctx.x: That’s great. Did you have a time back, I don’t know, maybe in March or something, a certain moment where you really started to believe that this pandemic was serious? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

It happened very quickly. It was funny because I saw that there were going to be some travel limitations and I was actually, I was ready to get a new car, and I think it was March 10th I got a Subaru Crosstrek anticipating that I’d probably be doing a lot of driving in California. Because I already had to cancel a tour of Taiwan. And then when I went out to dinner with a friend on the 12th of March and learned that he had a number of colleagues who had been hospitalized because they’d been on a skiing trip to…
Oh yea, the Original Dixieland Jazz Band.
